input.body: We are writing to request a review of a deduction of $21.50 on order UE-tf02b, dated 2026-11-05, which was applied with the reason "missing item" (Lamb Biryani). The order ticket lists Lamb Biryani, which shows the item was part of the order as placed [UE-tf02b:ticket_lists_item]. We recognise the ticket does not by itself show what was packed. Our records show the order was ready at 19:22 and picked up by the courier at 19:26, four minutes later [UE-tf02b:pickup_handoff]. This shows the order was handed off promptly after it was prepared. This is all the evidence we hold on the order. Based on it, we ask that you review the deduction and reverse it if the review supports that. Thank you for your time and consideration.
